contracts.claim: First task follows requested execute-first or docs-first policy, and UI objectives retain the preview acceptance gate.
PlanReceipt preserves goal, pending task schema, checks and bounded compact lists; raw docs never enter inputs.
Explicit selected skills override the brief; default skills and brief provenance survive compaction.
Validated unique dependency DAG compiles every step after its prerequisites; cycles fail before execution.
Compiled permission envelopes preserve lane scopes and risk; external/destructive writes require approval and proof-bearing steps retain proofRequired.
SHA256 and size bind the compiled canonical typed plan.
Every failed preflight check blocks readiness; missing/short/long synthetic key statuses remain bounded and masked.
Production profile keeps mission execution and receipt gates; capacity/approval work defers, unknowns hold, and admitted work ranks without loss.
Passed readiness skips notification; blocked readiness links exactly its failure count and reasons to the receipt.
Returned digest equals persisted JSON; counts match rows and markdown retains completed work, blocks, proof gaps and risks.
Headline shows newly used tokens with cache reads separate; unknown totals stay unknown and partial coverage remains labelled.
Invalid order/widget requests refuse before durable state/events; valid layout patches preserve omitted fields and return the emitted patch.
Host-grounded public view.arrange schema exposes four regions and left/right dock; pane.show exposes replay, builder and accounts.
Scene switch/save are exclusive and cannot overwrite built-ins; invalid themes refuse; known chats float/unfloat through the durable UI bus.
Bounded search returns only root-confined positive-line text matches satisfying the glob; generated/binary files are excluded, and timeout never claims completeness.
Interactive user surfaces must be shared apps with independent GitHub source, never tools.
Normalized equality yields zero error; aggregate quality, latency and peak VRAM retain their observations and denominator.
Explicit bounded override wins; automatic routing prefers native text, then requested fast GPU path, structured GPU path, scanned GPU text, or CPU fallback.

Receipt validation rejects stale source/time, mismatched history, invisible tab/modal states, undefined text, poor contrast, unsafe paths and sensitive keys. This validates receipts and does not authenticate a browser capture.
Every available bounded instruction receipt hashes current local source; compiled design capsule proof gates and complete plan hash remain bound.
Office operations enforce advertised operation identity and input schema; adapters lacking executable support return a truthful unavailable receipt.
Candidate registry requires unique identity, license and source; known production OCR identities retain their defined roles and CPU emergency fallback is ineligible for promotion.
Integrity receipts fail closed without authoritative change evidence; read-only protection is identified separately, and observed pre/post changes preserve bounded files, state and provenance.
Complete before/after SHA256 snapshots identify modified, created and removed files plus the unchanged case; incomplete snapshots never fabricate content evidence or replace adapter claims.
Only completed dependency ancestors enter context; bounded salient reply, route and status remain ahead of raw runtime compartments/tool noise.
Persisted immutable route identity/version enters base context first, ahead of bounded turn history; its sanitized projection matches the original conversation metadata.

The normal adaptive execution prompt preserves the explicitly selected task-profile identity, full compiled adaptive contract and original user request; authored instruction branches retain their existing precedence.
